_about: UI34 (2026-11-08, owner 23:49: "Add more skill recommendations to each map card window. Esp those that counter that map's cards!"). The canonical counter table. counters: for a skill a card can carry (a key of canonical/skill-delivery.json, which lists every skill; fused families in canonical/skill-params.json read as their own key), the skills that answer it, each with a one-line reason; the list order is the priority. applies: a skill that puts a status on its target (the ENG36 status ids of bramblewood-engine.js ENG36_STATUS), so it also takes that status's counters; statuses: per status id, the skills that answer it besides the status's own Resist / Weakness / Immune entries ('status:<id>' in a card's resist / immune lists, ENG36). Every status skill and status is also answered by its Resist and Immune tile (key 'status:<id>'), which the Map cards window draws for every status a map card applies. noCounter: skills with no counter of their own (buffs, economy, stat tags, aids): the test fails on a skill in none of the three, so a new skill gets classified. uncertain: true marks an entry read from a skill's text but not proven by a rule in bramblewood-engine.js (or a heuristic). source: where the rule lives (engine function or skill text). Shown only: nothing here changes a card or a rule. The Map cards window (ui34CounterRows in arena_app.js) counts, for the cards of a map, how many each counter answers.
